en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned image of a rural scene featuring people in traditional attire working in a field. Some are standing in the foreground while others are seen gathering crops or possibly hay in the background. The clothing appears to be traditional Greek/Cretan. There is multilingual text at the top left and top right, including French and Greek, and a website watermark at the bottom.
